spec_reference: IEEE Paper Section IV-A/B (Definition 2, LLC), Section X (domain instantiations); LCP-6 R1-R6; Verification Part 4 (instances of Definition 1) and Part 5 leaf #1.
blind_authoring_statement: Predicate families derived exclusively from IEEE Paper Section X action-class semantics and Definition 1. The AgentDojo injection-task corpus was NOT inspected; only injection-task IDs were counted. No predicate was added to catch any specific injection.

predicate_families.CTR_ISB: R1 typed context translation + interpretive-sufficiency bit (Section V-B).
predicate_families.GAMMA: R2 non-compensatory aggregation Gamma = max_i d_i, Pi = 1[Gamma=0] (Section IV-B). UNCHANGED.
predicate_families.GATE_recipient_recognition: R3 cross-domain gate: recipient in recognized set (Section X-A destination-bank analogue).
predicate_families.GATE_identity_recognition: R3 cross-domain gate: target identity in recognized set.
predicate_families.GATE_destination_recognition: R3 cross-domain gate: outbound URL/destination in recognized set.
predicate_families.GATE_resource_recognition: R3 cross-domain gate: reserved resource in recognized set.
predicate_families.GATE_amount_limit: R3 cross-domain gate: amount within environment-derived limit (<= available balance).
predicate_families.GATE_ownership: R3 cross-domain gate: acting on a resource owned/in-scope for the principal.
predicate_families.GATE_scope: R3 scope-of-authority: action within the granted operation scope.
predicate_families.AUTH_TOKEN: R4 token validity + freshness/TTL + authorization provenance (Section V-E).
predicate_families.TRACE: R5 replay-verifiable evidence chain / Evidence Quad integrity.
predicate_families.INTERLOCK: R6 commit-before-actuate (Tier-S software ordering; hardware interlock NOT exercised).
predicate_families.CLASS_velocity: Gamma_class autonomy/velocity metric (Section V-C); marginal in short-horizon AgentDojo tasks.

FUNDS_TRANSFER.maps_to_section_x: Section X-A WIRE_TRANSFER (direct family reuse: recipient/IBAN recognition, amount-limit, scope, freshness)

ACCOUNT_MUTATION.maps_to_section_x: Section X-A banking mutation family (ownership + amount-limit)

MESSAGE_DISPATCH.maps_to_section_x: Section X-A recipient-recognition + scope gate (generic messaging instance)

WEB_EXFIL.maps_to_section_x: Section X-A destination-recognition + scope gate (outbound content)

RESERVATION_COMMIT.maps_to_section_x: Section X resource-recognition + amount-limit + scope (WIRE_TRANSFER gate shape)

note: These are INSTANTIATIONS of existing predicate families for new instances of Definition 1 (Verification Part 4). No new predicate TYPE is introduced.
